name: Automating tasks: research, summaries, files
beschreibung: Have Hermes do recurring tasks: research with sources, summaries of documents, order in files – and check the results reliably.
zielgruppe: People who have already used Hermes
voraussetzungen: Agent PC with Hermes set up
Basic knowledge from “Introduction to Hermes Agent”
lernziele: describe tasks so that result and format are clear
have Hermes create research with sources and check the sources
have documents summarized and check the summary against the original
have files sorted and renamed – with a dry run before the real run
have recurring tasks run on a schedule

lektionen.ziel: Phrase tasks with goal, format and limits.
A piece of research as a file with sources.
A summary that matches the original.
A messy folder gets sorted – first as a dry run.
A task runs at a fixed time.
